book.name: HECHOS
book.title: Jesús' mitya kuinda kenueramula tyee dekeñuba Los Hechos de los Apóstoles

content: Dios: Espíritu Santo eenu tsuyu, timuwaami.
Teófilo, iya in ajke' kiikanu piiketu, Jesús peepundu tyee dekemuwaañu bain, tsenmin tyee demijakaamuwaañu bain juntsaa depiikiyu,
tsenmin ya kai'sha malungama ya' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramu mi'ke' kayamu rukulanu Espíritu Santochi tsanguikaatu naa naakenu deeñuba demijakaamuwaave.

Tsai' bene peya' mangujtatu yalanu chachi juu mangatawamuwaami, naa uwain chaiba chu'ba mijakaanu, tsejtu 40 malu ingama yaichi entsai mangatawandu, Diosnu rei juu tananu kuinda bain demijakare' pave.
Jesús kayu yaiba bulu putu, entsandimuwaami: Chaiba Jerusalén aa pebulubi demalu' miityusa tenve, in Apa tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu titu ñullanu naatiñuba, iya tsandyeesu juntsa keena' kai'mujchiya.
Uwain Juanya pichee mungaave, tsaaren ñullaa wajturen Espíritu Santaa deka' juntsachi mungaraiñuinu detsuve, timi.
Jesús kai'sha malumi.
Tsejtu junu wa'namula Jesúsnu pake'meetu: Bale Ruku, ¿Israel chachillanu challaren yai tene uuden manguen chunuu tirenu juyu, naa vee chachillachee uuden juu dechuñuba? tila.
Tsenñu Jesús tsandimi: Naamaa tsaa puinuuñuba, Aparen tsanguenuu tireñu jumuya ñulla mija' chunu dejutyuve,
tsaaren Espíritu Santo ñullanu jamiya, in mitya patinuu detirenu tsuve, tsejtu Jerusalénnu bain, Judea tusha bain, Samaria tusha bain, naa nuka bain in mitya pas nenu detsuve, timi.
Tsandi depa' dyatu, yala dekeenaren, Jesús yaikaya' kai'sha maluntsuren, ñivijcha ja' dishukiñu mangatai'la.
Tsejtu junu Jesús kai'sha naa-i maluntsuñuba deke'laanaren, pai ruku fiba jali panaa tene katawatu,
tsandila: Galilea' chumu rukula, ¿nenñu denayu selusha yuj ke'laanala? Entsa Jesús, ñulla selusha maluntsu kataadekishu juntsaren, naa-i miji'ba juntsai maanu tsuve, tila.
Judas' mitya manbunu, Matíasnu mi'ke' kala.
Tsenñu Jerusalénsha ma kilumetru tingumanainsha miila, saaduma lekanu malunu naa-i bare' nenuu uuden juñuba, tsantsa bareensha Ulibu chi chunu butyusha deputu.

Tsai' aa pebulusha demiitu, yala' kajnanu yanu katyu dijkisha malu' chula. Pedro bain, Juan bain, Santiago bain, Andrés bain, Felipe bain, Tomás bain, Bartolomé bain, Mateo bain, Alfeo' na Santiago bain, Simón, Diosa' lei naatiñuba tsa deki'ñu selandyamu tinu ruku bain, Santiago' na Judas bain junga pula.
Kumuinchi entsalaa naa-uwanuba ma pensaa juu Diosba kuinda kenu waku wakudila, tsenmin mantsa supula bain, Jesúschi ya' ama María bain, tsenmin Jesúschi ya' naatalala bain.
Juntsa malutala, keenguemu rukula 120 ma wakudena, Pedro yala' kejtala uidi' patu tsandimi:
Keranguemu naatalala, Espíritu Santo Davidnu tsandikare' piikikaañu, Jesúsnu yala' kundaalanu wandi' kakaakishu juntsa Judas naa-inu tsuve ti' laapu' piikemuwaañuba juntsaitu ive.
Judas bain laaba bulu nemuwaave, tsejtu laaba taawasha kes nemuwaave, timi Pedro.
(Tsaaren bene juntsangue' firu' kemishtin mitya lushi depaanguiñu, juntsa lushinchi tu ati'kamuwaami, tsaaren kai'sha lupajtya' naa peshiliba delaapajtyaimi.
Entsaiñu Jerusalén' chulla demijatu, juntsa tunu Hacéldama mumu pula, yala' palaachiya “Asa shajaananu tu”, titu.)
Tsaaren kumuinchi entsainuuñuba Salmos liburunu yumaa entsa pillawaami:

content.text: Ya' chunu ya tiba chutyu tsaa yajchin juu tiyaisa,

content: Tsenmin vee mujtu bain entsandive:

content.text: Tsenmala, ya tyee ken chumuñuba, veelaa tsanguen demachusa,

content: Enu pumu rukula naa-uwanuba lala Jesúsba bulu chungama laaba bulu neneimulaa depuve. Tsa' mitya Juan mungares nenu malutala nemiren, Jesús peya' mangujpa' selusha malungama bulu nemunaa main mi'ke' kalaanu meneste deeyu, laaba buudi' Jesús uwain peya' mangujñuba pareju kuinda kes nemu mandirenu.
Tsejtu pai rukunu laala: mainya José, tsandityumee Barsabás, tsenmin tsandindendyunmalaa, Justo tinu rukunu; kamainnuya Matíasnu laala.
Tsejtu Diosba kuinda ketu tsandila: Bale Ruku, ñuya main main tenbukasha ti pensa deeñuba mive, entsa pai rukulanu, naajaa ñuchi mi'ke' kayañuba mijakaaka,
tsenmalaa Judas ujcha la' peyatu nukaa jinuu ju'ba tsa-i' piyañu' mitya ya' taawasha manganutsu, tila.
Tsejtu entsa pai rukulanu, munaa tyulla luñaa juntsa taawasha manganuu juñuba deke'keeñu, Matíasnaa lumi, tsenñu juntsa malunuren Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramu 11 ruku jumulaba mabuudimi.
